# Evaluation report (generated by `python -m src.eval.run --report`; do not edit by hand)

LLM used for every system in this report: **deepseek** (results in `data\processed\eval\deepseek_importer`). Numbers from different LLMs are never mixed.

**Read this first.** The test set is small, part of it is written by Claude (synthetic, not checked by a customs expert), and the real part comes from public Pakistani rulings (mostly one Karachi classification committee) and leans to machinery, electronics and chemicals. Intervals are wide. Real and synthetic results are never averaged. Systems are compared on the same cases only.
